scores.title: 你离开的事实 · The Truth That You Leave

sourcePolicy: EOP images explicitly offered for free personal learning; intact original watermarks retained. Modern scores are private library data, not bundled for redistribution. Classical source licences are retained. No purchases.
limits: EOP scores are community piano editions, not exact G.E.M. studio transcription claims.
Truth repeat/coda unfolds100 printed bars into115 practice bars. Rolled chords play together; final nonnumeric rit. stays at selected practice tempo.
Tornado grace notes have editorial short timing, while bar50 glissando uses its written endpoints.

Classics use complete note/timing editions with simplified engraving/expression; original PDFs retain performance markings. Moonlight original PDF contains the complete source sonata; practice entry is movementI only.
This content-only pass tests simulated app playback/hand input, not physical MIDI hardware or a real acoustic-piano performance.
